name: Sunward
description: Planets lit on one side, every terminator turned so the bright half faces a big sun rising out of the top corner of the sheet in a wide glow.

code.style: --rule: ( --ps: @p(24%, 30%, 36%, 44%); --jx: @r(-12%, 12%); --jy: @r(-12%, 12%); background: radial-gradient(ellipse @calc((min(@X, @Y) / 2) * 100)% @calc((min(@X, @Y) / 2) * 100)% at @calc(50 + ((0.6 - @X / 2) - @dx) * 100)% @calc(50 + ((0.6 - @Y / 2) - @dy) * 100)%, var(--color2) 0 34%, transparent 34%), radial-gradient(ellipse @calc((min(@X, @Y) / 2) * 100)% @calc((min(@X, @Y) / 2) * 100)% at @calc(50 + ((0.6 - @X / 2) - @dx) * 100)% @calc(50 + ((0.6 - @Y / 2) - @dy) * 100)%, var(--color3) 34%, transparent 100%); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; width: @var(--ps); height: @var(--ps); left: calc(50% + @var(--jx) - @var(--ps) / 2); top: calc(50% + @var(--jy) - @var(--ps) / 2); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color1); transform: rotate(@calc(atan2((0.6 - @Y / 2) - @dy, (0.6 - @X / 2) - @dx) * 180 / PI)deg) scale(@calc(((sqrt((@dx - (0.6 - @X / 2)) ^ 2 + (@dy - (0.6 - @Y / 2)) ^ 2) > (0.34 * (min(@X, @Y) / 2)) + 0.55) * 1))); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: @var(--ps); height: @var(--ps); left: calc(50% + @var(--jx) - @var(--ps) / 2); top: calc(50% + @var(--jy) - @var(--ps) / 2); border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-clip-path: inset(0 0 0 50%); clip-path: inset(0 0 0 50%); transform: rotate(@calc(atan2((0.6 - @Y / 2) - @dy, (0.6 - @X / 2) - @dx) * 180 / PI)deg) scale(@calc(((sqrt((@dx - (0.6 - @X / 2)) ^ 2 + (@dy - (0.6 - @Y / 2)) ^ 2) > (0.34 * (min(@X, @Y) / 2)) + 0.55) * 1))); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
